controls.label: Thermal glow
controls.qualification: Black-body colour at its measured dayside temperature, 1,213 K. The disc itself is unresolved.
controls.notes: The colour of WASP-39 b's heat: a black body at the dayside brightness temperature measured in secondary eclipse at 3.6 µm (Spitzer Space Telescope satellite Infrared Array Camera (IRAC)). Its star lights the day side; the night side is not measured. Reflected starlight is not included.
